proves.claim: the clock the board state carries equals the document stored in board meta key clock.health.

store.io-board-state-clock.carries-clock.why: Without this case the watch could show a clock that differs from the one the clock pass stored.

proves.claim: with no stored clock document the board state carries clock null.

store.io-board-state-clock.null-when-abs.why: Without this case a board that never ran a clock pass would show a made-up clock.
